justification: The only meaningful overlap is the presence of nonrepresentational linear/geometric marks, and even that is generic: A has repeated angular painted signs beside a horned animal skull, while B has a frontal anthropomorphic figure with circular and curved carved features. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by a schematic human-like body/face scheme, whereas A combines a real or represented horned skull with rows of abstract signs and no comparable anthropomorphic figure.
